question: Is the following claim true? The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
source: author-written for this project; verified by the author

claims.text: The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 Exposition Universelle in Paris.
The 1889 World's Fair celebrated the centennial of the French Revolution.
The tower was officially opened on 31 March 1889.
The historical record consistently gives 1889 as the completion year.
Some people may associate the tower with 1887, the year construction started.
The broadcast antenna was added in 1957, and some may link the tower with that later date.
The 1887 start date and the 1957 antenna addition do not change the completion date.
The meaning of 'completed' is somewhat ambiguous (fair start, structural finish, or opening), but all fall in 1889 or at its start.
The claim is true that the Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
